note: Pinned canonical bytes and hashes for one BytesTransferredReceipt. Any implementation of this receipt in any language must reproduce every value below byte for byte. Never edit a value here to make a red test green: a disagreement means signatures produced on one side are refused on the other, and this file is the only thing that says so before a deployment does.
